subject: Quantix Health — evaluation roadmap & exec decision timeline
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@quantixhealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example
Cc: Tom Benson <tom.benson@quantixhealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks + next steps from today's discovery

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for a helpful call this morning. Tom and I felt confident that Redwood's runtime and the deployment options you outlined could address our latency and data-control requirements. A couple of follow-ups from our side so we keep momentum: 

- Can you send a short POC playbook with success criteria we should measure? We'll use that to align engineering and clinical ops.
- What's the minimal data/access you'll need for a 4-week trial (sample volume, VPC peering, any config changes)?
- We have an executive review window the week of April 12 — can you outline a proposed readout cadence so we can lock that slot?

Also looping in procurement later — we'll need a rough SOW + cost estimate to surface internally.

Appreciate it,
Sara Liu
Head of Product, Quantix Health
From: aditya_rao@redwood.example
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@quantixhealth.com>
Cc: Tom Benson <tom.benson@quantixhealth.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.example, marcus_lin@redwood.example
Date: 2027-03-20T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks + next steps from today's discovery

Sara —

Great talking with you both. High-level answers in-line, and attached is a concise POC playbook and draft SOW so Quantix can start internal alignment. I put a one-page success criteria matrix in the workbook; the short version:

- Performance: 95th-pct latency < 250ms for our targeted 512-token conversational workload
- Throughput: sustained 12 reqs/sec (burst to 40) during clinical batch inference windows
- Data controls: private VPC peering + audit logs enabled (no model telemetry retention)
- Quality: 2 sample clinical prompts with >= 85% accuracy on extraction tasks (as measured by your test set)

Minimal access we need: a small sample dataset (de-identified), an IP/CIDR for VPC peering, and a short list of expected peak concurrency. We can run the 4-week trial with a dedicated Redwood Private instance (we'll provide a lightweight ops checklist).

Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): sign-off on POC scope & SOW (we can provide a redline-friendly PDF)
- Week 1: infra setup, data ingest (2–3 days), smoke tests
- Weeks 2–4: instrumented trial (we'll stream metrics to the shared Drive)
- Week 5: internal readout + exec decision (we recommend a 30-minute readout + 15-minute Q&A)

If the April 12 executive window is still the target, we should start infra and SOW sign-off this week. I've attached: Quantix-POC-Success-Criteria.xlsx and Redwood-POC-SOW-v1.pdf.

Next step: Sara, can you confirm stakeholders for the readout (exec names) and who on your side will own data prep? I'll coordinate with Neha on the test harness and Marcus on the infra checklist.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Benson <tom.benson@quantixhealth.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@quantixhealth.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.example
Date: 2027-03-22T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Thanks + next steps from today's discovery

Thanks Aditya —

We're aligned on the criteria. A couple of clarifications from our infra team:
- We prefer to avoid long-lived peering during the trial; will a temporary VPC peering (2–6 weeks) with strict egress rules work?
- On the sample dataset: we'll provide a de-identified dump and a JSONL test set with labeled ground truth (expect to hand that off by Friday).

On exec owners: CFO (Alicia Park) and VP Clinical (Dr. Rajesh Menon) will attend the readout. Procurement will want a cost estimate and SOW redlines ahead of the readout. I've CCed procurement (procurement@quantixhealth.com) so they see the SOW.

Tom
Director of Engineering, Quantix Health
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.example
To: aditya_rao@redwood.example, marcus_lin@redwood.example
Cc: Sara Liu <sara.liu@quantixhealth.com>, Tom Benson <tom.benson@quantixhealth.com>
Date: 2027-03-24T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Quantix POC responsibilities + infra checklist (shared with customer)

Team —

Drafting a short ops plan to share with Quantix today. Key ownership: 
- Neha: trial instrumentation, metric dashboards, eval harness (will import Quantix JSONL labels)
- Marcus: network + VPC peering setup, audit-log config, runbook for failover to hosted model variant
- Aditya: customer-facing coordination and exec readout slides

I'll attach the network checklist to the shared Drive link and drop a small runbook for the temporary peering flow (we'll support a 2–6 week window and revoke keys after). Marcus — please confirm if we need any additional firewall rules from Quantix.

Plan to send the combined ops + SOW redline to Sara/Tom by EOD so procurement has time to review before their internal deadlines.

Neha Kapoor
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.example
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@quantixhealth.com>, Tom Benson <tom.benson@quantixhealth.com>, procurement@quantixhealth.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.example, marcus_lin@redwood.example
Date: 2027-03-30T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Finalizing readout slot & decision framework (April exec window)

Sara/Tom —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on data and the confirmation on attendees. Per your April 12 exec slot, proposed schedule: 

- April 12, 14:00–14:30 PT — Quantix readout (Aditya/Neha): trial summary, key metrics, demo of two clinical flows
- April 12, 14:30–14:45 PT — Decision window with execs (Alicia Park, Dr. Menon) — go/no-go recommendation and proposed next steps (commercial terms)

Decision criteria (what we'll present to make the recommendation):
1) Performance SLA met: 95th-pct latency < 250ms for target workload AND no production-impacting errors during trial
2) Quality gate: extraction accuracy >= 85% on agreed test set
3) Ops readiness: VPC peering completed, audit logs enabled, and a rollback plan validated

Procurement — attached is Redwood-POC-SOW-v1.pdf with a short redline summary. We estimate the 4-week trial cost (infra and reserved capacity) and have a commercial placeholder in the SOW — we can tighten this post-readout.

Sara — can you confirm the April 12 slot and approve Alicia/Dr. Menon as the decision-makers? If we get a firm yes, I'll reserve that slot and start prepping the readout deck.

Best,
Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

-----
Attachments referenced: Quantix-POC-Success-Criteria.xlsx, Redwood-POC-SOW-v1.pdf, network-checklist.docx
